architectural_fidelity.reason: Room geometry preserved: same ceiling height with crown molding, window position and size correct, gray walls maintained, camera angle identical, fireplace and radiator covers in correct positions.

furniture_removal.reason: Critical failure: original carpet pattern and stains clearly visible throughout the floor, creating ghost impressions that make the space look unfinished and unprofessional.

style_commitment.reason: Unmistakable Art Deco commitment: dramatic dark marble feature wall with gold geometric inlay and ginkgo leaf motifs, period-appropriate recessed lighting, classic Art Deco color palette of black, gold, and jewel tones.

editorial_density.reason: Severely under-styled: vast empty floor space, single visible furniture piece (partial sofa), minimal accessories, no rugs, no layered textiles, no styled vignettes—reads as abandoned renovation rather than luxury staging.

photorealism.reason: Feature wall rendering is strong with realistic marble veining and metallic inlay, but floor treatment looks unfinished with visible original carpet remnants; lighting and shadows are competent but space feels incomplete.

designer_preference_reason: Collov delivers complete, client-ready staging with proper furniture removal and editorial density, while Cova's visible carpet remnants and empty space make it unpresentable despite superior style execution.
what_cova_does_better: Dramatically superior style commitment with authentic Art Deco feature wall
Architectural preservation is excellent with accurate room geometry
Bold design vision that shows clear creative direction
what_collov_does_better: Complete furniture removal with clean floor finish
Fully furnished and styled space ready for client presentation
Proper editorial density with layered textiles, art, plants, and accessories
Professional staging completeness from floor to ceiling
specific_fixes_if_failing: Complete floor replacement: remove all visible original carpet patterns and stains with clean marble, hardwood, or luxury carpet appropriate to Art Deco style
Add full furniture layout: velvet sofa, accent chairs, coffee table, console table with Art Deco lines
Layer in editorial density: geometric area rug, sculptural floor lamp, styled coffee table vignette, decorative objects on mantel
Add 3+ textile layers: throw pillows, area rug, window treatments
Include greenery and multiple light sources for lived-in luxury feel
